originalFrozenTask.learnerTask: Match measurement accuracy, clinical association and test-guided-strategy utility to distinct evidence.
originalFrozenTask.gap: No visual shows three separate evidence questions and the unsupported action bridge in practice.
originalFrozenTask.accuracyGuardrails: Use parallel evidence questions rather than an inevitable validation ladder. Analytical accuracy, clinical association and test-guided utility do not substitute for one another or establish an action from a research result.

generatorCustody: Privately retained original construction code, not publicly delivered. SVGs are editable; no executable reproduction package promised.
sourceDepth: Actual selected primary/official passages or primary abstracts; per-owner private lookup receipts identify exact reading depth, failures and custody. No whole-paper, clinical or current-platform validation implied.
sourceCustody: Source bodies and reading/execution/capture receipts retained privately.
themeMethod: Shared original geometry/text with palette substitution only
